**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The document contains no non-compete or field-of-use restriction binding Northwind:

- **§ 12.3** is an affirmative protection in our favour — it confirms nothing restricts us from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, or conducting business in any field or territory, and that we have made no exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, minimum-volume or no-hire commitment. This exceeds the playbook's preferred position.
- **§ 12.4** does restrict competing development, but it binds **Vendor**, not us, so it benefits our party and is not flagged.
- **§ 13.4** (reverse engineering of hosted source code, with the mandatory-law carve-out preserved) is standard IP protection rather than a restrictive covenant.

No further action required on this rule.
